# Type Alias: TransitionResult

> **TransitionResult** = \{ `message?`: `string`; `status`: `"accepted"`; \} \| \{ `message`: `string`; `status`: `"rejected"`; \}

A hook either permits the edge or rejects it with a character-facing reason.

## Remarks

Reject before applying effects. Rejection keeps the conversation at
its current node, and later attempts may retry. Earlier effects are not undone.
